items.title: Permission status copy needs domain terms
items.finding: The generated permission table reuses generic stock status copy. Role access review needs Active, Review, and Risk wording.
evidence: Generated Permissions page renders a status column from shared StatusBadge copy.
Permission Review flow calls out risky role assignments as the user goal.
items.proposedChange: Add a reusable rule for page-level status copy mapping when the same Badge variants serve different business domains.
acceptance: Permission status copy uses Active, Review, and Risk.
Badge variants still follow semantic severity.
Future generated pages can keep copy mapping outside kit components.

items.title: DataGrid needs first-class pagination display
items.finding: Generated list pages can pass harness without pagination even when the page plan describes list workflows that normally need paging.
evidence: Inventory List page plan uses DataGrid for operational records.
DataGrid exposes a pagination slot but no default pagination helper exists in component manifest.
items.proposedChange: Add a lightweight Pagination component or DataGrid pagination recipe before promoting generated list pages to examples.

promotionEvidence.componentPlan: Add a kit-owned Pagination helper or a documented DataGrid pagination slot recipe.

acceptance: List page generation can show paging intent through a kit-owned API.
Harness can check paged list scenarios without custom UI classes.

items.rejectionReason: Sample project is a validation-sandbox (see business-context.json). Promoting its purchase order form into examples/ would harden a fictional ERP scenario into the kit's demo layer. Revisit after a real-product brief lands: pick a form page from the real flow instead.
items.title: Purchase order form is a candidate demo
items.finding: The generated form page combines Stepper, FormSection, Select, Input, Textarea, and action hierarchy in a reusable B-side pattern.
evidence: Generated Create Purchase Order page builds from the form-page pattern.
The page covers supplier, lines, delivery, review notes, and draft action states.
items.proposedChange: Promote the purchase order form into examples after copy and data fields are reviewed.
acceptance: Demo description records the PRD, flow, and page intent source.
Preview Examples can still build after promotion.
